children: Neil Dougherty, an officer serving as EVP, CFO, reported a direct sale of Common Stock on 2026-09-21. The shares were sold at $340.785 per share. The total sale amount reported is $681,570. Following the transaction, Dougherty directly owns 123,389 shares of Common Stock. Footnote: the ownership figure includes 117.258 shares acquired in an Employee Stock Purchase Plan under Section 423 of the Internal Revenue Code in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-3.
